title: An ECG foundation model for zero-shot transfer from hospital to point-of-care devices
abstract: arXiv:2608.03690v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) recording is moving from hospitals to point-of-care devices that record one or two leads, where public labelled data is too scarce to build foundation models (FMs) as for 12-lead ECGs. Whether existing 12-lead FMs transfer to these devices without retraining is unknown. We show that seven published FMs reach a zero-shot AUROC of 41-81% on two real point-of-care datasets and, when reduced to one or two leads, lose 12-35 AUROC points on average and gain 0.15-0.23 in mean absolute error across 29 benchmarks covering 1,673 clinical targets. We present RELAY, a 7-million-parameter FM that represents ECGs as graphs of segments from whichever leads are recorded, without filling missing ones or knowing their identities. translated_title: 一种用于从医院到床旁检测设备零样本迁移的心电图基础模型
translated_abstract: 心电图（ECG）记录正从医院转移到仅记录一或两个导联的床旁检测设备上，而这类设备的公开标注数据过于稀缺，无法像12导联心电图那样构建基础模型（FM）。现有12导联基础模型能否在不重新训练的情况下迁移到这些设备上尚属未知。我们展示了对两个真实床旁数据集，七个已发表的基础模型的零样本AUROC仅为41-81%；并且，在涵盖1,673个临床目标的29项基准测试中，当输入减少到一个或两个导联时，这些模型平均损失12-35个AUROC点，平均绝对误差增加0.15-0.23。我们提出了RELAY，一个700万参数的基础模型，它将心电图表示为由所记录的任意导联的片段构成的图，无需填充缺失导联或知晓导联身份。RELAY在920万条12导联心电图上进行了预训练，使用12导联时具有竞争力，在两个床旁数据集上均排名第一（AUROC分别为87.6%和81.5%），并且在随机使用一个和两个导联时，分别在29项基准测试中的26项和22项上排名第一。
tldr: 提出了RELAY，一个700万参数的心电图基础模型，它将任意导联的ECG表示为片段图，无需填充缺失导联即可实现从医院12导联数据到床旁单/双导联设备的零样本迁移，并在床旁数据集及大多数基准测试中排名第一。
en_tdlr: RELAY, a 7-million-parameter ECG foundation model that represents ECGs as graphs of segments from whatever leads are recorded without filling in missing ones, enables zero-shot transfer from hospital 12-lead data to point-of-care single/dual-lead devices, ranking first on both point-of-care datasets and most of 29 benchmarks.
